byteward.title: Orbelle launches 40 internet satellites
byteward.author: Simone Achterberg
body: [f01: Orbelle launched 40 internet satellites overnight.] [f05: It was the company's 11th launch.]

[f03: All 40 satellites have made contact with ground control, Orbelle said.] [f02: That brings the company's fleet to 412 satellites in orbit.] That's a solid start for a network this young, if a long way from finished.

[f04: Orbelle plans to start selling internet service in mid-2027.] Until then, each launch is mostly about proving the system works. The pace of launches matters more than any single one, and Orbelle will need to keep it up.

launch-desk.title: Orbelle launches 40 more internet satellites
launch-desk.author: Inez Calder
body: [f01: Orbelle put 40 more internet satellites into orbit overnight.] [f04: Service starts in mid-2027.] [f06: It will cost $89 a month.]
[f07: The company has raised $2.3 billion so far.] [f08: It needs 1,200 satellites in orbit by March 2030 to keep its spectrum license.] That's a lot of launches, and a lot of money, still to come.

ohm-and-bit.title: Orbelle launches another 40 internet satellites
ohm-and-bit.author: Rafe Okonkwo-Hart
body: [f01: Orbelle's latest launch carried 40 internet satellites.] [f09: They'll operate at an altitude of 590 km, low enough to keep the delay on a connection short.]

[f10: Each satellite weighs 310 kg.] [f11: Instead of bouncing every signal off the ground, the satellites pass data to each other by laser.] That means fewer ground stations, but each laser terminal adds weight and power draw to a small spacecraft.
[f02: With this batch, Orbelle has 412 satellites in orbit.] That's enough to test the network, not to run it.

bench-and-bill.title: Orbelle launches 40 internet satellites as a license deadline looms
bench-and-bill.author: Celia Marchetti
body: [f02: The latest launch brings Orbelle to 412 satellites in orbit.] [f08: Under its Federal Spectrum Office license, the company must have 1,200 in orbit by March 2030.]
[f12: If it falls short, the office can shrink the license to cover 600 satellites.] [f13: The license also requires Orbelle to move dead satellites out of orbit within five years.]
The deadline leaves Orbelle little room for a failed launch.

wirefold.title: Orbelle launches 40 internet satellites
body: Orbelle launched 40 internet satellites overnight, bringing its fleet to 412 as it prepares to start service in 2027.
